text:
ana (PM): hey all — posted the draft PRD for the 'Adaptive Inference Controls' initiative in Google Drive: https://gdrive/reports/ai/adaptive-inference-prd
ana (PM): high-level ask: we need cross-team sign-off on scope, acceptance criteria, and launch gating. Trying to finalize by EOD Thu so we can include in next roadmap sync. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
mike (Eng): skimmed it. main technical risk is the fallback policy complexity when quantized models are used vs full-precision. can we defer advanced routing to v1.1?
ana (PM): mike — noted. proposal in doc has a v1a/v1b split, but it's fuzzy. Suggest we solidify v1a minimal scope here in thread.
tara (UX): UX request — we need clear error states and copy for the degraded-mode UI. If routing falls back, users must see a consistent message. I added 3 mock screens in the doc.
marco (Sales): customer asks: two pilot accounts require regional isolation and deterministic latency guarantees. They insisted on a firm SLA for p95 < 200ms. Flagging as blocking for them.
sam (SRE): p95 < 200ms is doable on Dedicated but not hosted standard. We should add explicit routing policy: prefer Dedicated for SLA customers, hosted is best-effort. Also include rollout plan: canary -> 20% -> 100% with automatic rollback on latency regression.
ana (PM): acceptance criteria draft below — please thumbs up or comment inline:
- AC1: API parity — text-gen endpoints keep same contract and schema as current API
- AC2: p95 latency for SLA customers <= 200ms under stated load profile
- AC3: graceful fallback behavior: when primary model unavailable, system returns 503 with structured reason and transparent fallback note in metadata
- AC4: QA regression tests for hallucination rate on model variant <= +2% compared to baseline
- AC5: rollout automation with canary + auto-rollback triggers
mike (Eng): small nit: AC3 should say return 200 with fallback response in most cases (to avoid breaking client parsing). 503 only for hard outage. propose: default to 200 + "x-fallback-used: true" header.
ana (PM): good point — updated in doc. changing AC3 to default 200 + header unless request explicitly set prefer-strict:true
riley (Data): for AC4 — what metric for hallucination? we need a concrete eval harness and threshold. propose: use the open-eval suite v2, metric = factuality_score, threshold >= 0.88.
ana (PM): riley — added that exact metric to AC4.
marco (Sales): for pilot customers, they also want version pinning per-tenant. That should be in scope for v1a if it's a requirement to close deals.
mike (Eng): version pinning per-tenant increases complexity (deploy matrix + storage). alternative: allow routing stickiness to model-tag that we can control. can we accept that as equivalent for v1a?
marco (Sales): sticky model-tag is fine as long as it gives them deterministic behavior. Will confirm with customers.
tara (UX): quick edge-case: what happens when model-tag pinned model is decommissioned? need copy and remediation flow. Add to edge-cases.
sam (SRE): added SLOs/monitoring checklist to the doc: token-level cost alert, sudden increase in latency, cache-miss surge, and KV cache corruption detection. Also added a runbook for failover to read-only mode.
triage-bot: deploy-checklist created: /checklists/adaptive-inference-deploy, owners: mike, sam, riley
ana (PM): ok, two tradeoffs to decide here that need stakeholder sign-off:
1) Scope tradeoff: include per-tenant version pinning in v1a (sales asks) vs push to v1.1 and offer migration path
2) SLA exposure: advertise p95 <200ms for "Dedicated Pilot" only vs advertise as platform SLA
ana (PM): propose decisions:
- Decision A: postpone per-tenant version pinning to v1.1; provide sticky model-tag for v1a (owner: mike)
- Decision B: publish p95 <200ms as Dedicated Pilot SLA only; platform-wide SLA to be evaluated after pilot (owner: sam)
mike (Eng): +1 Decision A. reduces risk and keeps timeline.
marco (Sales): reluctantly agree on Decision A if we commit to v1.1 timeline (target: Q3) and provide interim guarantee with sticky tags.
sam (SRE): +1 Decision B. we can only guarantee platform SLA after pilot telemetry.
riley (Data): adding: owner for hallucination regression alerts will be Riley (data) and eng oncall (sam) for ops.
ana (PM): ok, I'll update the PRD decisions section and add a short decision log entry. I need sign-off emoji from each stakeholder by EOD Thu to lock scope.
tara (UX): :white_check_mark: tara
mike (Eng): :white_check_mark: mike
sam (SRE): :white_check_mark: sam
marco (Sales): :white_check_mark: marco (will confirm with pilot customers tomorrow)
riley (Data): :white_check_mark: riley
ana (PM): thanks, all. follow-ups assigned in doc: owners + due dates. Will schedule 30m cross-team sync to close open items tomorrow 10:30am.
mike (Eng): can we add a short bullets section in PRD for rollback criteria? I've pasted suggested triggers:
```
- sustained p95 increase > 20% for 5 minutes
- error rate > 1% for 2 minutes
- KV cache integrity check failure
```
sam (SRE): agreed, adding automated rollback hook.
marco (Sales): please include a single-paragraph summary we can share with pilot customers after sync.
ana (PM): will draft summary and post to this thread after tomorrow's sync. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
